'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Central African Republic Civil War (2012–present)|Central African Republic Civil War]]
**Three [[United Nations]] [[United Nations peacekeeping|peacekeeper]]s from [[Burundi]] are killed and two others injured in the [[Central African Republic]] during two attacks by unknown gunmen. The shootings are carried out two days before the [[2020 Central African general election|general election]] in the country. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55451763 (BBC News)]

*A boat overturns and sinks due to strong winds on the [[Uganda]]n side of [[Lake Albert (Africa)|Lake Albert]], killing 26 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55449328 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in China]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
*****The [[Government of Hong Kong|authorities]] extends the compulsory [[quarantine]] in designed hotels to 21 days for visitors from outside [[China]], [[Macau]], and [[Taiwan]] beginning tomorrow and also ban all people who stayed in [[South Africa]] over the past 21 days from entering [[Hong Kong]] in order to prevent the spread of [[Variants of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|new variant]]s of [[SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/hong-kong-imposes-21-day-quarantine-for-visitors-adds-south-africa-to-banned-list (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 258 deaths and 6,324 recoveries in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide totals to 20,847 deaths and 570,304 recoveries. [https://m.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20201225142208-20-586257/kasus-positif-tambah-7259-sembuh-dan-meninggal-pecah-rekor (CNN Indonesia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports their first cases of the new variant of SARS-COV-2 in five people who arrived from the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/12/25/national/tokyo-coronavirus-884-cases/ (''The Japan Times'')] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kyrgyzstan]]
****[[Kyrgyzstan]] surpasses 80,000 cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-12/25/c_139618736.htm (Xinhua News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Lebanon]] reports their first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in a passenger on a [[Middle East Airlines]] flight from [[London]] on December 21. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/world/mena/lebanon-detects-first-variant-covid-case-on-flight-from-london-1.1134867 (''The National'')]

***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 1,241 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total to 54,770 cases. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201225001051320?section=news (Yonhap News Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[France]] reports their first case of the new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in a French citizen who travelled from [[London]] to [[Tours, France]] on December 19. [https://news.sky.com/story/covid-19-france-discovers-its-first-case-of-the-new-coronavirus-variant-after-frenchman-travelled-from-london-12172620 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[Chief Medical Officer (Ireland)|Chief Medical Officer]] [[Tony Holohan]] confirms that the [[Republic of Ireland|Republic]] has detected the new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from the United Kingdom as the country reports more than 1,000 for the first time in two months. [https://www.independent.ie/world-news/coronavirus/new-uk-variant-of-covid-19-confirmed-in-ireland-while-1025-new-cases-and-two-further-deaths-confirmed-39900087.html (Independent.ie)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[Federal Service for Surveillance on Consumer Rights Protection and Human Wellbeing|Rospotrebnadzor]] orders a 14-day quarantine for anyone who travels from the United Kingdom, with the exception of aircraft crew members, beginning tomorrow due to the spread of a more contagious variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/12/25/russia-imposes-14-day-quarantine-for-uk-arrivals-due-to-mutated-virus-a72488 (''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 Nashville bombing]]
**An explosion occurs in a [[recreational vehicle]] in downtown [[Nashville, Tennessee]], U.S., causing structural damage and injuring three people. [[Metropolitan Nashville Police Department|Police]] believe the explosion was an "intentional act". [https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/25/us/nashville-explosion/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.tennessean.com/story/news/local/2020/12/25/downtown-nashville-explosion-christmas/4044635001/ (''The Tennessean'')]
**The explosion also results in [[AT&T]] service outages across the U.S. due to infrastructure damage to a service facility located near the blast site. Cellular, wireline telephone, Internet, and [[AT&T U-verse|U-verse]] television service, as well as multiple local [[9-1-1]] and non-emergency phone networks, are among the services affected. [https://www.wkrn.com/news/local-news/att-outages-across-tennessee-kentucky-affecting-multiple-911-services/ (WKRN-TV)] [https://www.tennessean.com/story/news/local/2020/12/25/att-outage-internet-down-hours-after-nashville-explosion/4045278001/ (''The Tennessean'')]
*[[2018 Puebla helicopter crash]]
**Four people are arrested for a helicopter crash in [[Puebla]], [[Mexico]], that killed [[Governor of Puebla|Governor]] [[Martha Érika Alonso]], her husband, and former Governor [[Rafael Moreno Valle Rosas]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/arrested-mexico-crash-killed-current-governor-74912283 (ABC News)]
*A court in Russia sentences prominent historian [[Oleg Sokolov]] to 12 and a half years in prison for the [[murder]] and [[dismemberment]] of his student lover. Sokolov, a former history professor at [[St. Petersburg State University]], pled guilty to the murder. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-murder/russia-jails-historian-for-12-5-years-for-grisly-murder-of-student-lover-idUSKBN28Z0PV?il=0 (Reuters)]
